story.title: Nothing launches on-device AI dictation tool supporting over 100 languages
story.summary: Consumer electronics brand Nothing has released an AI-powered dictation tool that processes speech entirely on-device, supporting more than 100 languages without sending audio to the cloud. The tool is designed to work across Nothing's hardware lineup, prioritising user privacy by keeping voice data local. The launch positions Nothing as an early mover in private, multilingual on-device AI assistants for everyday users.
